# Read-only AWS CLI commands for quota-preflight. Mirrors
# infra/cloudformation/quota-preflight/quota-preflight-role.yml; the IAM role is the
# real boundary, this list keeps the agent from even trying anything else.
Bash(aws service-quotas get-service-quota *)
Bash(aws service-quotas get-aws-default-service-quota *)
Bash(aws service-quotas list-service-quotas *)
Bash(aws service-quotas list-aws-default-service-quotas *)
Bash(aws service-quotas list-services *)
Bash(aws service-quotas list-requested-service-quota-change-history-by-quota *)
Bash(aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics *)
Bash(aws cloudwatch get-metric-data *)
Bash(aws cloudwatch list-metrics *)
Bash(aws autoscaling describe-account-limits *)
Bash(aws cloudformation describe-account-limits *)
Bash(aws dynamodb describe-limits *)
Bash(aws elbv2 describe-account-limits *)
Bash(aws iam get-account-summary *)
Bash(aws lambda get-account-settings *)
Bash(aws rds describe-account-attributes *)
Bash(aws route53 get-account-limit *)
Bash(aws ses get-send-quota *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-addresses *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-internet-gateways *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-security-groups *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-subnets *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-transit-gateways *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints *)
Bash(aws ec2 describe-vpcs *)
Bash(aws eks list-clusters *)
Bash(aws ecs list-clusters *)
Bash(aws s3api list-buckets *)
